content:
Although using Claude on a desktop computer is not a new feature, the ability to run it in the background is a welcome upgrade.

Anthropic announced today that the background computer use feature of Claude Code is now available, currently supporting only macOS systems, and is provided to Pro and Max users.

After OpenAI integrated Codex into ChatGPT, it was the first to introduce the background computer use feature for Mac earlier this year. It is great to see Anthropic's Claude Mac app catch up with its counterpart.

When AI-powered computer use means handing over mouse control to an agent, its practical use is greatly diminished. When the feature can run in the background, it brings a significant multitasking breakthrough to Mac.

Learn more about computer use features for Claude Code and Cowork.

Make the most of your Apple products' performance
